article.excerpt: Christopher Phillips, Battle Ground: Ten Conflicts that Explain the New Middle East . A good, “simple enough” introduction to the wars going on in Syria, Yemen, and other parts of the Middle East. If you are worried you will hate, you can just skip the Palestine chapter.
